reading.body:
James Walkinshaw's AI record is legislative and financial: eight AI bill cosponsorships, two recorded votes, and four committee contributions from Microsoft, Google, and Amazon PACs.

The legislative activity clusters in workforce and governance. Bills on AI job impacts, workforce training, and the workforce of the future sit alongside sectoral governance, literacy and learning, and research resources measures. One cosponsorship concerns intelligence reporting on AI use under Section 702. The pattern is a member engaging AI through labor and education policy rather than through compute, data centers, or electricity.

The money is corporate and modest. Microsoft's PAC gave twice, $1,000 each, in December 2025 and May 2026. Google's PAC gave $1,500 in February 2026, and Amazon's PAC gave $5,000 the same month. These are committee contributions recorded in FEC filings, not evidence of any effect on the bills listed.

What the data does not show is causation or motive, and the page states that placement in date order is not a claim that one event caused another. It also does not cover the content of the two bills voted on, only that the votes were yea. Nothing here addresses compute, buildings, or power directly, so the record speaks to AI governance and campaign finance, not to the infrastructure constraint.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for James Walkinshaw: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 13 events.
